name: trait UnsignedBytewiseOrd
rule: For every `x` and `y` of a type implementing `UnsignedBytewiseOrd`, `Ord(x, y)` must return the same value as `Ord::cmp(transmute::<_, u8>(x), transmute::<_, u8>(y))`.
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides no quantification over values of Self or observations of Ord::cmp and transmute results.
